{{Top|leg}}
'''Tobacco''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] whose leaves were dried and smoked to produce a calming and sometimes mildly euphoric effect. Dried tobacco leaves could be smoked in various pipes or rolled into [[cigarette]]s and cigars.
